stage: Stage 6 measurement readiness; not completion-effect evaluation

asset_scale.mode: declared synthetic scale, not original physical dimensions

camera.oracle_instance_mask: shared by all conditions; no mask estimation claim

gripper.anchor: mean of full valid segmented optical cloud, no GT/completion
gripper.order: width, roll, z_offset, x_offset; ascending stored lists
gripper.selection_utility: minimize x_offset^2+z_offset^2, then candidate id; independent of completion/GT
gripper.purpose: static pose object collision only; no table, robot arm, swept path, force closure or lift; fixed 10 cm retreat is a collision-clearance fallback, not a successful grasp

readiness_gates.integrity: all frozen hashes and asset hashes match
readiness_gates.geometry: finite triangles and nondegenerate area; every welded undirected edge has two opposite directed incidences. This is not a full vertex-manifold or self-intersection proof. Query-specific containment must independently agree.
readiness_gates.camera: all 4 cases have >=2048 unique pixels/points, 32 stable interior ray sentinels; explicit numeric and depth checks pass; repeat depth/seg bytes identical
readiness_gates.collision: independent triangle-box clipping and ray parity agree with PyBullet surface contact + solid-angle containment away from near-contact ambiguity
readiness_gates.support: every case retains >=1 robust collision and >=1 robust clear candidate; all 32 records retained
readiness_gates.oracle_representation: 8192 and 32768 area-uniform GT point controls both match robust full-geometry labels exactly; otherwise point representation unresolved

baseline_plan.status: defined before readiness outcomes; real completion execution requires a later frozen adapter/protocol
baseline_plan.observed_only: point membership in the union of the three gripper boxes, same 0.5 mm dilation for all point representations
baseline_plan.completion: observed points union independently generated points; copied output suffix counted once
baseline_plan.consistent_completion: same plus remove only generated points projecting into a valid observed ray with positive depth smaller than measured depth minus 0.75 mm; outside/invalid rays stay unknown
baseline_plan.conservative: Reject if any point on a fixed 2 mm lattice covering all three gripper boxes is outside a valid observed ray or is not at least 0.75 mm in front of measured depth. Include box boundaries. This is a discrete unknown-occupied control, not continuous-volume safety certification.
baseline_plan.oracle_controls: evaluation-only full mesh and fixed 8192/32768 area-uniform surface points
baseline_plan.report: per-candidate label changes, false-clear/false-collision, selected candidate truth and abstention, useful candidate rejection; all four cases, no significance/generalization claim
baseline_plan.density: both oracle densities must pass readiness; generated/observed source counts retained; no output-dependent density adjustment

disconfirmation: No case replacement, threshold or pose-grid changes after actual readiness labels. Failure pauses interpretation. Passing is measurement support, not a robotics benefit or native-method result.
